Description: This tender competition is for the delivery of a health coaching-aligned and physical activity coaching programme as part of a multi-disciplinary obesity care programme to 5000 patients living in the Derry GP Federation area. PEACETIME is a cross-border research project and will include work in Donegal, but respondents to this tender competition are bidding for delivery of work in the Derry GP Federation area only. This tender competition is being managed by the Derry GP Federation, who are a partner in the PEACETIME project. A contract between the Derry GP Federation and the tenderer(s) will be finalised ahead of formal go ahead for the delivery of the project. Service Providers are requested to submit a tender, only if they are confident that they have the requisite experience and expertise as outlined in the project documentation, commencing as soon as is practicable after award of contract.
